name: pli
description: Open-source document, sheet, deck, board, form and PDF SDK for JavaScript, Swift and Kotlin.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sheets-react && tsc --noEmit -p packages/decks-react && tsc --noEmit -p packages/pdf-react && tsc --noEmit -p apps/playground && tsc --noEmit -p examples/capacitor && tsc --noEmit -p packages/editor-host
scripts.native: pnpm --filter @pli.dev/native build && pnpm --filter @pli.dev/native generate && pnpm --filter @pli.dev/editor-host build
scripts.native:test: pnpm native && (cd packages/swift && swift test) && (cd packages/kotlin && ./gradlew test)
scripts.release:dry: pnpm build && pnpm release:check && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm release:check && changeset publish
